adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` returns either `fetchTokens.res` (non-sync path) or a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` (credential-sync path, see new `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). The Google code then does `const token = res?.data;` and assigns `googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token` / `expiry_date = token.expiry_date`. A `fetch` `Response` has no `.data`, so on the sync path `token` is `undefined` and these fields become `undefined`, and the subsequent `prisma.credential.update` persists the corrupted credential. (Additionally, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` is used incorrectly here, but the reported `.data` issue is directly verifiable from the diff.)
